title: WakeMark docs
description: Guides for getting started, importing history, exports, Notion sync, Chrome and Raycast extensions, and the WakeMark MCP server.

hero.title: Guides
hero.subtitle: Learn what WakeMark does, follow the quickstart, import your full X bookmark history, or connect WakeMark to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other MCP clients.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.body: What WakeMark is, who it is for, and the core capabilities that turn X bookmarks into a searchable library.

quickstart.title: Quickstart
quickstart.body: Connect X, sync your bookmarks, and start searching — the essential flow in a few minutes.

extension.title: Chrome extension
extension.body: Install, sign in, search bookmarks from the toolbar, and Ask AI in the popup or side panel.

raycast.title: Raycast extension
raycast.body: Search bookmarks and Ask AI from the launcher. History import stays in Chrome.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.body: Give agents secure access to your bookmarks. Setup, client configs, and tool reference.

importHistory.title: Import history
importHistory.body: Bring years of X bookmarks into WakeMark with the Chrome extension — not just the newest 20 from the official API.

export.title: Export bookmarks
export.body: Download Markdown, JSON, or CSV exports for Obsidian, backups, and custom scripts.

notion.title: Notion sync
notion.body: Connect Notion, create a Wakemark Bookmarks database, and auto-sync AI-ready bookmarks.
